title: Goodwill Allowed on a Settled Event Bill
content:
A goodwill adjustment is allowed on a Private Event & Banquet Services final bill up to the ceiling printed against the package, worked on the contracted event value the guarantee priced to, and an adjustment beyond that ceiling is not made at the desk. What it comes to is settled by the credit claims standing on the booking in the event request log, and it comes off what the client settles.

1. Where two or more credit claims on the booking stand approved in the event request log, the adjustment is the ceiling percentage printed against the package.
2. Where exactly one credit claim on the booking stands approved in the event request log, the adjustment is the single-claim percentage, being 5 per cent.
3. Where no credit claim on the booking stands approved, no goodwill adjustment is made.

The value the percentage is worked on is the contracted event value the guarantee priced to, that being the value the guarantee entry carries for the booking.

## The ceiling each package prints

| Package | Ceiling percentage | Single-claim percentage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 15 | 5 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 20 | 5 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 25 | 5 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 30 | 5 |
| Gala Reception Package | 35 | 5 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 30 | 5 |

## Worked illustration on hypothetical records

A booking on the Seated Banquet Package whose guarantee entry carries 24000 has two approved credit claims standing against it in the event request log. The adjustment is 30 per cent of 24000, that is 7200, coming off what the client settles. With exactly one approved claim it would be 5 per cent of 24000, that is 1200; with none, nothing at all. Claims standing in review or declined are not approved claims.
